title: RBI Imposes Monetary Penalty on Jilla Sahakari Kendriya Bank Maryadit, Shajapur, Madhya Pradesh
description: <cite index="61-10,61-11,61-13">RBI imposed a penalty of ₹1 lakh on Jilla Sahakari Kendriya Bank Maryadit following a NABARD inspection. The bank had failed to transfer eligible unclaimed deposits to the Depositor Education and Awareness Fund within the prescribed time limit.</cite>
